# Mando TV

> Mando TV is a universal TV remote app for phones and computers (iPhone, iPad, Android and Windows). It controls Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Roku and Google TV / Android TV televisions (Sony, Philips, TCL, Hisense, Sharp, Xiaomi, Toshiba, Panasonic, Haier, Skyworth, Chromecast with Google TV and others), plus Fire TV (Fire TV Stick, Fire TV Cube and TVs with Fire TV built in, paired with a 4-digit PIN), over the home Wi-Fi network. It does not mirror the phone screen. It has no ads, needs no account, and Mando TV has no servers that store what you do. The remote is free; Pro is an optional one-time purchase with no subscription.

Key facts:

- Free: remote buttons (arrows, OK, back, home, volume, channels, mute), phone keyboard to type on the TV, turn the TV on over the network, automatic TV discovery, several TVs, and Easy mode with big buttons.
- Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription): touchpad, voice commands, routines, sleep timer and more. The exact list is on the home page of each language.
- Connection: today over Wi-Fi (phone and TV on the same network, no internet needed). Infrared (Android phones with an IR blaster) and Bluetooth (Android) are in development and not available yet.
- Platforms: App Store (iPhone and iPad), Microsoft Store (Windows) and early access on Google Play (Android).
- Languages of the app and the site: Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, German and Italian.
- Privacy: the app controls the TV directly inside the home network, without going through the internet. The website counts visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics (no cookies) and uses Google Analytics only if the visitor accepts.
- Contact: hola@mandotv.app

- [Turn on a TV without the remote](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/turn-on-tv-without-remote/): power button by brand, HDMI-CEC, power-on from the phone

## TV remote app by brand (English)

Each page says which systems that brand uses and which ones Mando TV controls (Roku TV, Google TV / Android TV, Fire TV and most Hisense VIDAA models) and which ones it does not (for example Xumo TV, Titan OS and TVs powered by VIZIO). Some recent VIDAA models only accept Hisense's official app; Mando TV detects it and says so.

- [Sony](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/sony-tv-remote-app/), [TCL](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/tcl-tv-remote-app/), [Hisense](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/hisense-tv-remote-app/), [Insignia](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/insignia-tv-remote-app/), [onn.](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/onn-tv-remote-app/), [Toshiba](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/toshiba-tv-remote-app/), [Sharp](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/sharp-tv-remote-app/), [Philips](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/philips-tv-remote-app/), [Westinghouse](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/westinghouse-tv-remote-app/), [Pioneer](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/pioneer-tv-remote-app/), [Vizio (not supported, real options)](https://mandotv.app/en/guides/vizio-tv-remote-app/)
